positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description:
-Provide excellent customer service  and product knowledge 
-Advise customers on personal style and outfitting 
-Engage with customers in a meaningful way upon entering the store
-Use organization skills to maintain sales floor cleanliness
-Responsible for meeting weekly sales goals

positions.title: Appliance Sales Consultant
positions.description:
-Maximize revenue growth by using customer service and sales skills
-Educate and provide assistance to customers about products and services
-Execute operational and sales processes to ensure sales performance standards are met
-Handle customer concerns as they arise on the sales floor

positions.title: Receptionist
positions.description:
-Provided information on foreign language services to students
-Communicated and interacted with the professors in the department
-Answered all incoming calls and handled the caller’s inquiries 
-Maintained office organization and cleanliness

positions.title: Pool Attendant
positions.description:
-Supervised pool area
-Attended state-mandated customer service class
-Ensured the safety of all pool patrons
-Assisted customers with questions and concerns
-Enforced pool policy and procedures 
-Maintained cleanliness of pool facilities

honors.title: Linda H. and Edward Bradley Endowed Scholarship in Arts and Letters
honors.description: Awarded to one undergraduate student in the College of Arts and Letters with a minimum GPA of 3.0.
honors.issuer: Issued by Old Dominion University · Nov 2013
